# Synthetic MPEP-layout fixtures

**These are not MPEP text.** The pages copy only the *layout* of an official
MPEP section page (navigation, then `NUMBER Title [R-MM.YYYY]` headings, a
`[top]` marker and the chapter table of contents). The section numbers (99xx)
do not exist in the MPEP, and every sentence is placeholder text labelled as a
fixture. They exist so the parser and ingestion can be tested without network
access and without putting invented legal text next to real section numbers.
